name: doks-root
description: Local-first collaborative workspace for markdown notes and infinite canvas whiteboards

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=shared && npm run build --workspace=web && npm run build --workspace=agent
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit --project shared/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit --project agent/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit --project web/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit --project tests/tsconfig.json
